In the Go codebase at /bench/home/work, find all call sites of Store.GetUser. Search for ".GetUser(" across all Go files. List each caller with its file path and line number. Use grep to find them all.

Run: grep -rn "\.GetUser(" /bench/home/work --include="*.go"

Also check if GetUser is defined as an interface method or struct method, and find its definition.
